models.name: Qwen3.5 2B
models.note: Half the size and twice as fast. Uses about 1.5 GB of memory while it runs. Its verbs come out stiffer — "utilized" where the larger ones write "used".

models.name: Qwen3.5 4B
models.note: The one to pick if it fits: about 3 GB of memory, and it tightens a bullet without changing the register you wrote it in.

models.name: Qwen3.5 9B
models.note: Keeps the most of what you meant, and takes about twice as long as the 4B. Wants roughly 5.5 GB of memory free while it runs.
